levels.surface: أبي زرعة بن عمرو بن جرير

notes: The bare «محمد» (second occurrence, «عن محمد، قال حدثنا شعبة») is written as the text gives it; nothing is added from the lexicon.
Abu Dharr's own addition («قال أبو ذر خابوا وخسروا») is his speech in the Companion's account, no new route; the Prophet is not a link.
